description: The template gallery (roadmap M1.4): each sample scene the New Game dialog offers, with its title, genre and a one-line summary. The dimension comes from the scene's own gameMode. 'web' marks the scenes whose every script has a web-player port (engine-babylon samples.test.ts, run headless, not in a browser). A preview is templates/previews/<scene name>.png when it exists; regenerate them with tools/make_template_previews.py.

templates.title: 2D Platformer
templates.summary: Run and jump across platforms, collect coins and reach the goal.

templates.title: 2D Platformer (Tiles)
templates.summary: The 2D Platformer with its platforms painted as tiles: reshape the level in 2D Studio: Tiles. Plays exactly like the original.

templates.title: Pixel Adventure
templates.summary: A pixel-art platformer on a tile map with animated sprites, coins and pits.

templates.title: Tilemap Level
templates.summary: An auto-tiled level whose solid tiles collide; two sprite heroes fall onto it.

templates.title: Breakout
templates.summary: Bounce the ball off the paddle and break every brick.

templates.title: Space Shooter
templates.summary: Fly, fire and survive waves of enemies that get harder over time.

templates.title: 2D Physics Sandbox
templates.summary: Box2D crates, ramps and bouncy blocks with no scripts.

templates.title: Sprite Animation
templates.summary: A pixel-art sprite playing its idle and walk animations.

templates.title: Sprite 2.5D
templates.summary: The pixel hero in a 3D world seen from the side.

templates.title: Ruins Runner
templates.summary: Side-scroll through a 3D ruin with moving platforms, spikes and checkpoints.

templates.title: Platformer Profile
templates.summary: A 2.5D level with no scripts: its genre and game mode supply the side camera, running and jumping.

templates.title: Platformer Profile (Terrain)
templates.summary: The Platformer Profile on a terrain ground you can sculpt into slopes in World: Terrain. Plays like the original.

templates.title: Hybrid Side-scroller
templates.summary: A sprite hero runs past a Kenney house and trees: 3D scenery edited in 3D Modeling, 2D sprites in 2D Studio, drawn in depth order.

templates.title: Platformer Profile 3D
templates.summary: Guide Detective Bunny across floating stones with the chase camera. The genre profile still handles running, jumping and restarting after a fall.

templates.title: Three Heroes
templates.summary: Switch between three heroes with different abilities to get through the level.

templates.title: Grapple Gorge
templates.summary: Swing across chasms on a grappling rope; push a crate onto a plate to open a gate.

templates.title: Fighter
templates.summary: One-on-one fighting against the computer, best of three rounds.

templates.title: Gem Collector
templates.summary: Roll around a course collecting gems against the clock.

templates.title: Lane Runner
templates.summary: An endless runner: change lanes and jump obstacles as the speed rises.

templates.title: Platform Hopper
templates.summary: Jump between floating platforms to reach the goal.

templates.title: Obby
templates.summary: A six-stage obstacle course with checkpoints, lava, moving platforms and coins.

templates.title: Circuit Racer
templates.summary: A three-lap race against two rival cars, with engine sounds.

templates.title: Arena Shooter
templates.summary: A first-person shooter: survive three waves of drones.

templates.title: Crate Puzzle
templates.summary: Push every crate onto a target in four grid puzzles.

templates.title: Block World
templates.summary: Walk a world of blocks in first person, dig it out and build with it.

templates.title: Character Playground
templates.summary: A walking character with steps, ramps, crates and a chase camera.

templates.title: 3D Physics Sandbox
templates.summary: Balls and a crate pyramid to kick, push and pop with the physics script API.

templates.title: Physics Joints
templates.summary: A hinged door, a pendulum, a chain and a slider driven by joints.

templates.title: Mesh Colliders
templates.summary: Balls, boxes and rocks rolling over a terrain that collides as a mesh.

templates.title: Terrain Valley
templates.summary: A heightmap valley to reshape with terrain brushes.

templates.title: Poly Haven Showcase
templates.summary: Downloaded CC0 assets: wood, brick and rock PBR materials and two glTF models (a rollershutter door and a stone fire pit).

templates.title: First-person Range
templates.summary: A firing range with no scripts: its genre and game mode supply the view from the eyes, walking, strafing and a shot that knocks crates off the shelf.

templates.title: Third-person Yard
templates.summary: A walled yard with no scripts: its genre and game mode supply a camera behind the Gunner, turning, strafing and a level shot that knocks crates over.

templates.title: Action RPG Valley
templates.summary: Explore a 3D valley with textured boulders, animated wildlife and a third-person camera.

templates.title: Action RPG Courtyard
templates.summary: A 2.5D courtyard with no scripts: an isometric camera, walking and jumping; the hero starts at the spawn point.

templates.title: Landscape Valley
templates.summary: A valley of models: terrain, a lake, mountains, trees, rocks and a cabin.

templates.title: Landscape Valley (Terrain)
templates.summary: The Landscape Valley on an editable terrain: reshape the valley and paint it in World: Terrain, scatter pines from Objects, and walk the hero over it in Play.

templates.title: Landscape Valley (CC0)
templates.summary: The Landscape Valley on its editable terrain, with Kenney's CC0 oaks, pines, rocks and bushes in place of the generated ones: each one a prefab you can move, place more of from Objects, and walk around in Play.

templates.title: Desert Canyon
templates.summary: Dunes, red rock mesas, an oasis and cacti under a warm sun.

templates.title: Desert Canyon (Terrain)
templates.summary: The Desert Canyon on an editable terrain you can reshape, repaint and scatter on; the hero walks the dunes in Play.

templates.title: Alpine Valley
templates.summary: Snowy hills, a frozen lake, pines and snow-capped mountains.

templates.title: Alpine Valley (Terrain)
templates.summary: The Alpine Valley on an editable terrain you can reshape, repaint and scatter on; the hero walks the snow in Play.

templates.title: Tropical Island
templates.summary: A beach ring, palms, rocks and two huts in a sea.

templates.title: Tropical Island (Terrain)
templates.summary: The Tropical Island on an editable terrain you can reshape, repaint and scatter on; the hero walks the beach in Play.

templates.title: Autumn Forest
templates.summary: Rolling hills with red, orange and yellow oaks, a pond and a cabin.

templates.title: Autumn Forest (Terrain)
templates.summary: The Autumn Forest on an editable terrain you can reshape, repaint and scatter on; the hero walks the hills in Play.

templates.title: Material Showroom
templates.summary: Shapes that share material files: rock, wood, water and more.

templates.title: Sculpted Rock
templates.summary: A rock made in sculpt mode.

templates.title: Character Creator
templates.summary: Three characters made with the character creator, walking and standing.

templates.title: Humanoid Animations
templates.summary: The humanoid animation templates: idle, walk, run, jump and fall.

templates.title: Animation Clips
templates.summary: The general animation clips, each playing on one entity.

templates.summary: Objects that spin, hop and greet, driven by node graphs.
